test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Ratnesh marked the price of a pencil box at Rs. 80. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the pencil box if after giving a discount of 10%, Ratnesh still gains 20%?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the pencil box = Rs. 80

Discount given = 10%

Gain = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) - Discount

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Gain%)

**Calculation:**

Discount = 10% of MP = 10% of 80 = 0.10 × 80 = 8 Rs.

Selling Price = MP - Discount = 80 - 8 = 72 Rs

Cost Price = SP / (1 + Gain%)

⇒ CP = 72 / (1 + 20%)

⇒ CP = 72 / 1.20 = 60

**The cost price of the pencil box is Rs. 60.**
